items.title: Universal closedness and properness are preserved by the factorization through a separated base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with two assertions: in a commutative triangle X -> Y -> B over S, if X -> B is universally closed and Y -> B is separated then X -> Y is universally closed (in particular the image of |X| in |Y| is closed), and if moreover X -> B is proper then X -> Y is proper (source lines 8170-8189). The proof of (1) factors X -> Y through the graph X -> X x_B Y, which is a closed immersion by the semi-diagonal lemma and hence universally closed, and the projection X x_B Y -> Y, which is a base change of the universally closed morphism X -> B; a composite of universally closed morphisms is universally closed. Part (2) combines (1) with separatedness, quasi-compactness and finite type permanence.
